messages.content: [system prompt omitted to save space — identical rendering rules as run2-t0.5, prompt revision before the Sunday-hours sentence]
Hello, you've reached Sakura Say-koh-tsoo-in. This is the clinic's AI receptionist, speaking in English. How can I help you today?
Yes, we are open tomorrow, which is Saturday, from nine in the morning until seven in the evening. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Should I put ice on it?
I'm sorry, I can't give medical advice. Our staff can talk with you about your symptoms when you visit or contact the clinic. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
Can I talk to someone at the front desk?
Of course. I can pass your details to our staff so they can call you back. May I have your name, please?
I need your full name, both given and family name, to pass along. What is it?
Thank you, Taro Yamada. May I have a phone number where our staff can reach you?
Excuse me, I'm not sure I caught all of that. Could you give me the phone number once more, please?
Thank you for confirming. Let me read back the number: zero eight zero, seven seven zero eight, three zero zero four. Is that correct?
